baseline:
**Project Title:** Attendance Management System

**Description:** A system that helps teachers manage attendance for students in any institution
requirements_list: allow teachers to update attendance records for students, tracking days when students are absent or present
have two main user roles: teachers and admins
allow admins to create records of students
allow admins to create records of students' roll numbers
allow admins to categorize students' records by section
allow teachers to access students' records
